name: Burleigh H Murray Ranch Prop
description: Burleigh H. Murray Ranch Park Property near Half Moon Bay is a quiet canyon park along Mills Creek with a trail past the historic Mills Barn, one of only two known bank barns in California.
fullDescription: Burleigh H. Murray Ranch Park Property near Half Moon Bay is a quiet canyon park along Mills Creek with a trail past the historic Mills Barn, one of only two known bank barns in California.
whatTheyOffer:
- Hiking along a ranch service road through Mills Creek canyon
- Historic Mills Barn (late 1800s dairy bank barn)
- Guided hikes and public programs offered occasionally
- Dogs allowed on the service road only, on a 6-foot leash
- No camping, fires, or drones
- Open 8 am to sunset; phone (650) 726-8819
howToGetIt:
California State Parks does not list a day-use fee for this park. A small parking area is available.

**Getting there:** From Highway 1 just over a mile south of Highway 92, turn east onto Higgins-Purisima Road and continue about 1.5 miles to the park.
address: 1980 Higgins Canyon Rd, Half Moon Bay, CA, 94019
